notes: 1. SCOPE / DOC_DRIFT-001 (MAJOR — live UI wins): The BRD (Module 7) and FS (BUYER-FS-Unit-Details) describe Unit Details as a rich standalone page with on-screen Unit specs, Cost Sheet, Tower View, Floor & Unit Plans and Payment Schedule sections at a route like /allotted-units or /my-unit. The LIVE UI (visual-memory/buyer/unit-details/INDEX.md, FULL capture 2026-06-03 on the WINNER account) shows NO such page — every /allotted-units, /allotted-unit, /unit-details, /my-unit route returns 404. In the live build, 'Unit Details' is the 'Download your Unit Details' button on the KYC success page (route /kyc?unitId=<base64>). That button produces the buyer's Booking-form / Unit-details PDF. Per the live-UI-wins rule, all UI-layer TCs here describe the KYC-success page + the download, NOT a rich on-page cost-sheet view. The rich on-page sections from FS/BRD are flagged [VERIFY WITH DEV] (may be a future/mobile-app feature, not in the captured web build).

2. ACCESS PATH: Unit Details (the download) is reached only via the KYC completion flow. From Home Dashboard, a booked (WINNER) registration shows a 'Complete KYC' CTA -> completing KYC lands on the KYC success page at /kyc?unitId=<base64-encoded-unitId> (example unitId param OTc1Mg== = base64 of unit id 9752). The KYC success page hosts the 'Download your Unit Details' button and a 'Go to Home' link (href=/home). There is no direct deep-link URL to Unit Details outside this flow.

3. WINNER PRECONDITION: Unit details / the download are available only after the buyer has WINNER status (confirmed unit booking with completed payment) AND has completed KYC. A non-WINNER buyer cannot reach the KYC success page and the cost-sheet/unit-details API returns 400 'Could not fetch unit data' (BR FS 1.5 Rule 1; controllers/allocation.controller.js:271-275).

4. KYC SUCCESS TABLE columns (visual-memory): Registration Number | KYC Number | Unit | No. of Applicants | Process Status. Example row (test account GHNG-1000008364-C): Registration Number GHNG-1000008364-C, KYC Number GHNG-1000008364-C-KYC, Unit '1201 - Glory, 1 Bed Growth Home (323 sq.ft.)', No. of Applicants '1 Applicant', Process Status 'KYC Completed'. Page heading h5='KYC submitted successfully!'.

5. PDF / BOOKING-FORM CONTENT: The downloaded Unit Details / Booking form PDF is built from getRegistrationUnitBookingFormData (Azure SAS-signed applicant document URLs) and shows Registration No, transaction IDs, Unit Number, Tower Name and all applicant details (Name, Mobile, Email, Address, Relationship, PAN, Aadhaar). There is NO server-side allotment-letter PDF endpoint (BYR_UNIT_029) — the download is client-side react-to-print and/or assembled from booking-form-data + Azure SAS URLs. Do NOT write TCs asserting a dedicated server PDF endpoint.

6. COST SHEET = FROZEN: Per FS 1.5 Rule 2, the cost sheet reflects pricing frozen at the time of allocation; later offer/admin-offer changes do NOT alter a confirmed booking. All applied discounts/offers (HOME_LOAN, VC_REQUEST, admin offers, early-bird) are included as deductions. This is verifiable via the unit-details/cost-sheet API for a WINNER booking; the live web build does not render it on a page (see note 1).

7. APPLICANT ORDER & RELATIONS: booking-form-data returns applicants with 'self' first (raw CASE WHEN, then ascending id) and relations title-cased on response ('sister' -> 'Sister') (controllers/user.controller.js:1017-1020). Documents are pre-signed Azure Blob SAS URLs (NOT S3), signed per request, not cached (controllers/user.controller.js:1059-1077).

8. KNOWN SCHEMA / API DEFECTS (carried from baseline — document, do not 'fix' in TCs): Unit.imageUrl is a '||'-delimited string the client must split, and trailing/leading delimiters or pipe-containing URLs corrupt parsing (models/unit.model.js:424-429). units.status ENUM contains 'REFUGE' — almost certainly a typo for REFUND/REFUSED (models/unit.model.js:177). Cross-tenant booking-form-data query returns an opaque 500 'Something went wrong' instead of 403/404 (controllers/user.controller.js:919-922) — security-by-obscurity.

9. [TEST_DATA_REQUIRED] = a disposable/state-specific UAT record must be supplied before executing this test (e.g. a fresh WINNER+KYC-completed registration with its unitId/registrationNumber, a non-WINNER buyer token, a cross-tenant registrationUnitId, an expired/aged JWT, an HCF order in VERIFICATION state, a unit with multiple floor-plan images, a unit with no milestones configured). UAT buyer mobile 8888888888 / static OTP 147258.

10. [VERIFY WITH DEV] = behaviour not confirmed in BRD/FS or contradicted by the live capture; confirm before treating Pass/Fail as authoritative. DOC_DRIFT-NNN = a documented live-vs-doc contradiction; the live UI value is used in the TC.

11. AUTH: Buyer portal URL is https://uat.xrportal.in/ (the Buyer host — NOT uat-web.xrportal.in). Login is Mobile-OTP only (UAT mobile 8888888888 / OTP 147258); the JWT is held in sessionStorage. JWT lifetime is ~24h (BR; exact value [VERIFY WITH DEV]). Logout / expiry is the buyer's standard auth behaviour; do not assert post-logout server-side token invalidation without dev confirmation.

12. GLOSSARY: 'Download your Unit Details' = the primary button on the KYC success page (button.ant-btn matching /download your unit details/i) that yields the Unit-details / Booking-form PDF. '1 Applicant' button = the applicant-count control (button.ant-btn matching /\d+ Applicant/). 'Go to Home' = link (a) matching /go to home/i, href=/home. 'Cost Sheet' / 'Floor & Unit Plan' / 'Payment Schedule' as on-page sections are FS-only (not rendered in the captured web build — note 1).

subModules.name: Access & Routing (KYC success page = Unit Details host)

tcs.scenario: To verify the KYC success page (Unit Details host) loads for a WINNER+KYC-complete buyer

1. Log in to the buyer portal (8888888888 / 147258).
2. From Home, open the booked registration and complete/continue the KYC flow to its success page (or open the KYC success URL /kyc?unitId=<base64>).
3. Wait for the page to finish loading.
tcs.expected: The KYC success page renders showing the heading 'KYC submitted successfully!', the congratulations text, the registration summary table and the 'Download your Unit Details' button. (Source: visual-memory unit-details-loaded-WINNER.png.)

subModules.name: Cost Sheet (frozen pricing) [FS — not on-page in live build]

tcs.scenario: To verify the cost sheet is frozen at allocation time
tcs.description: Verify the business rule that the WINNER booking's cost sheet reflects pricing frozen at allocation and is not altered by later offer/admin changes.
tcs.precond: A WINNER booking whose cost sheet is known. [TEST_DATA_REQUIRED] a WINNER booking + a subsequent offer change applied at admin/project level.
tcs.steps:
1. Record the booking's cost-sheet figures (via the unit-details/cost-sheet API for this WINNER registration).
2. Apply or simulate a later offer/admin price change at the project level.
3. Re-read the booking's cost sheet.
tcs.expected: The confirmed booking's cost sheet is unchanged after the later offer/admin change — pricing is frozen at allocation (FS 1.5 Rule 2). (Cost sheet is not rendered on a page in the live web build — DOC_DRIFT-001 — so this is verified at the API/data layer.)

tcs.scenario: To verify all applied offers/discounts appear as cost-sheet deductions
tcs.description: Verify that HOME_LOAN, VC_REQUEST, admin offers and early-bird benefits applied to the unit are reflected as deductions in the cost sheet.
tcs.precond: A WINNER booking that had a HOME_LOAN and/or VC_REQUEST offer applied. [TEST_DATA_REQUIRED] such a booking.
tcs.steps:
1. Fetch the WINNER booking's cost sheet.
2. Inspect the deduction/offer lines.
tcs.expected: Each applied offer/discount (HOME_LOAN, VC_REQUEST, admin offer, early-bird benefit) appears as a deduction, and the Net payable amount = Total unit value minus all deductions (FS Cost Sheet table + FS 1.5 Rule 3).

tcs.scenario: To verify the cost-sheet line items and total composition
tcs.description: Verify that the cost sheet exposes every documented charge line and that the total unit value sums them.
tcs.precond: A WINNER booking with a populated cost sheet. [TEST_DATA_REQUIRED] such a booking.
tcs.steps:
1. Fetch the WINNER booking's cost sheet.
2. Read the line items and totals.
tcs.expected: The cost sheet exposes Basic price, Floor rise charge, Premium charge, Infrastructure charge, Society charge, Clubhouse charge, Possession charge, GST amount, Parking charge, Total unit value, Offer/discount deduction, Early bird benefit and Net payable amount; Total unit value equals the sum of the charge components (FS Cost Sheet table). [VERIFY WITH DEV] exact field names/keys in the live API response.

tcs.description: Verify that the user-unit-details endpoint rejects a request missing the unitId query parameter.
tcs.precond: Authenticated WINNER buyer. [TEST_DATA_REQUIRED] API access.
tcs.steps: 1. GET /api/users/user-unit-details?registrationNumber=GHNG-XXX (omit unitId).
tcs.expected: 400 'Missing required query parameters: registrationNumber and unitId' (controllers/milestone-payment.controller.js:1491-1493). (Carried from baseline — Layer: API.)

tcs.scenario: Applicant documents pre-signed via Azure SAS
tcs.description: Verify that booking-form-data returns Azure Blob SAS-signed (per-request, non-cached) document URLs.
tcs.precond: WINNER buyer with KYC submitted. [TEST_DATA_REQUIRED] API access.
tcs.steps:
1. GET /api/users/registration-units/booking-form-data/<id>.
2. Inspect applicants[*].documents.
tcs.expected: Each document has an Azure Blob SAS URL (NOT S3), pre-signed per request (not cached). URL expiry should be tested at the SAS lifetime boundary (controllers/user.controller.js:1059-1077). (Carried from baseline — Layer: API.)

tcs.scenario: Applicants ordered with self first
tcs.description: Verify that booking-form-data returns applicants with 'self' first then ascending by id, and relations title-cased.
tcs.precond: Unit with applicants having relations spouse, sister, self, father. [TEST_DATA_REQUIRED] such a booking.
tcs.steps:
1. GET /booking-form-data/:id.
2. Inspect the applicants[] order and relation strings.
tcs.expected: 'self' is returned first via raw CASE WHEN, then ascending by id (controllers/user.controller.js:1017-1020); relations are title-cased on response ('sister' -> 'Sister'). (Carried from baseline — Layer: API.)

tcs.scenario: Allotment letter download endpoint does NOT exist
tcs.description: Verify the documented fact that there is no server-side allotment-letter PDF endpoint.
tcs.precond: WINNER buyer. (Source-review fact.)
tcs.steps: 1. Search the backend routes for an allotment-letter download endpoint.
tcs.expected: No such endpoint exists in routes/user.routes.js or routes/user/*.js. The InitialAllotment model exists with an association but no PDF endpoint. Any UI 'Download' must be client-side react-to-print OR built from getRegistrationUnitBookingFormData Azure SAS URLs. Do NOT write TCs asserting a server PDF endpoint. (Carried from baseline.)

tcs.scenario: To verify the unit-details API for a WINNER returns the full cost-sheet payload
tcs.description: Verify that the allocation unit-details endpoint returns the unit + cost-sheet data for a valid WINNER registration/unit pair.
tcs.precond: Authenticated WINNER buyer with a valid registrationNumber + unitId. [TEST_DATA_REQUIRED] API access + WINNER ids.
tcs.steps:
1. GET /api/users/allocation/unit-details?registrationNumber=<WINNER>&unitId=<id> with the WINNER's token.
2. Read the response.
tcs.expected: HTTP 200 with the unit identity and cost-sheet breakdown (charges, GST, deductions, net payable) for the booked unit. [VERIFY WITH DEV] the exact response field names/keys are not transcribed; confirm the schema. (Backs the cost-sheet TCs in 'Cost Sheet'.)

tcs.scenario: Unit.imageUrl is ||-delimited string (BUG)
tcs.description: Verify the documented schema defect that Unit.imageUrl stores multiple image URLs as a single '||'-delimited string.
tcs.precond: Unit with multiple images. [TEST_DATA_REQUIRED] DB access + such a unit.
tcs.steps:
1. Inspect the imageUrl field.
2. Set the value to 'url1||url2||' (trailing) and then '' (empty).
tcs.expected: The field returns the raw delimited string; the client must split by '||'. Trailing/leading delimiters and pipe-containing URLs corrupt parsing. Document as a BUG (models/unit.model.js:424-429). (Carried from baseline — Layer: DB.)

tcs.scenario: Unit.status ENUM includes REFUGE typo
tcs.description: Verify the documented schema defect that the units.status ENUM contains an apparent typo value 'REFUGE'.
tcs.precond: Schema inspection access. [TEST_DATA_REQUIRED] DB access.
tcs.steps: 1. Query the schema for the units.status ENUM values.
tcs.expected: ENUM = AVAILABLE, HOLD, BOOKED, REFUGE, PREBOOKED, PBT, RESERVED. 'REFUGE' is almost certainly a typo for REFUND/REFUSED (models/unit.model.js:177). Document as a schema BUG. (Carried from baseline — Layer: DB.)

tcs.scenario: To verify the unit shown in Unit Details matches the Home dashboard booked row
tcs.description: Verify cross-module consistency: the unit identity on the KYC success / Unit Details surface matches the Allotted Unit shown on the Home dashboard for the same registration.
tcs.precond: A WINNER+KYC-complete registration visible on Home. [TEST_DATA_REQUIRED] such a registration.
tcs.steps:
1. On Home, read the booked registration's 'Allotted Unit' value (e.g. '3502-Crest | 1 Bed Growth Home | 323 sq.ft.').
2. Open the registration's KYC success / Unit Details surface.
3. Compare the Unit cell value.
tcs.expected: The unit number, tower, configuration and area shown on the Unit Details surface match the Home dashboard 'Allotted Unit' value for the same registration (BRD Module 2 / Module 7 consistency).

tcs.scenario: To verify HOME_LOAN / VC offers earned in other modules appear in the cost sheet
tcs.description: Verify that a discount earned via the Home Loan flow or a VC_REQUEST is reflected in the unit's cost sheet.
tcs.precond: A WINNER booking for which a HOME_LOAN application and/or a VC was completed. [TEST_DATA_REQUIRED] such a booking.
tcs.steps:
1. Confirm a HOME_LOAN offer and/or VC_REQUEST discount was earned for the registration.
2. Fetch the unit's cost sheet.
3. Inspect the deductions.
tcs.expected: The HOME_LOAN / VC_REQUEST discount appears as a deduction in the unit's cost sheet (BRD Module 5 -> Unit Details cost-sheet integration; FS Cost Sheet 'Offer/discount deduction'). (Cross-module data flow documented in BRD.)

tcs.scenario: To verify the Unit Details surface is stable across a re-login (regression)
tcs.description: Verify that after logging out and back in, the WINNER buyer can still reach the KYC success / Unit Details surface with the same unit and a working download.
tcs.precond: A WINNER+KYC-complete registration. [TEST_DATA_REQUIRED] such a registration.
tcs.steps:
1. Log out of the buyer portal.
2. Log back in (8888888888 / 147258).
3. Re-enter the registration's KYC success / Unit Details surface.
4. Confirm the unit identity and the Download button.
tcs.expected: After re-login the KYC success / Unit Details surface renders the same registration, unit identity and a functional 'Download your Unit Details' button — no regression in access or content.

tcs.scenario: To verify a booking at the maximum applicant count (4) renders correctly
tcs.description: Verify that the summary and document handle the maximum of 4 applicants (primary + 3 co-applicants) without truncation.
tcs.precond: A WINNER booking with 4 applicants. [TEST_DATA_REQUIRED] such a booking.
tcs.steps:
1. Open the KYC success / Unit Details surface for the 4-applicant booking.
2. Read the No. of Applicants control.
3. Generate the Unit-details document and confirm all 4 applicants appear.
tcs.expected: The applicant-count control reads '4 Applicants' and the generated document lists all four applicants (self first) with no truncation (BRD KYC max 4 applicants).

tcs.scenario: To verify a unit with a very long name/tower string does not break the summary cell
tcs.description: Verify that a long unit/tower/configuration string in the Unit cell wraps/truncates gracefully rather than breaking the table layout.
tcs.precond: A WINNER booking whose unit string is unusually long. [TEST_DATA_REQUIRED] such a booking, or [VERIFY WITH DEV].
tcs.steps:
1. Open the KYC success page for the booking.
2. Inspect the Unit cell rendering.
tcs.testData: [TEST_DATA_REQUIRED] booking with a long unit string
tcs.expected: The long unit string wraps or truncates within the cell without breaking the table layout or overflowing the viewport. [VERIFY WITH DEV] no captured example of a long unit string; confirm against the live render.

tcs.scenario: Unit imageUrl with a pipe-containing URL corrupts split parsing (boundary)
tcs.description: Verify the boundary case of the '||'-delimited imageUrl when an individual URL itself contains a pipe character.
tcs.precond: A unit whose imageUrl contains a URL with an embedded '|' character. [TEST_DATA_REQUIRED] such a unit (extends BYR_UNIT_032).
tcs.steps:
1. Set imageUrl to a value where one URL contains an embedded pipe (e.g. 'https://x/a|b||https://x/c').
2. Render the floor-plan / image surface.
tcs.expected: The naive split-by-'||' mis-parses the pipe-containing URL, producing a broken/incorrect image entry — confirming the parsing fragility documented in BYR_UNIT_032. Document as a manifestation of the imageUrl schema BUG. [VERIFY WITH DEV] exact client split behaviour.
